text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT fired: GPU_MEMORY_PRESSURE on pool=dedicated-west2a-large-3 (threshold=85%). sample_metric: gpu_mem_used=91% (node: gw-02, pid: 21345)

pagerduty: PagerDuty P22278 triggered -> unacked for 30s

maya (oncall): acked. I'm looking. seeing repeated cuMemMap failures in logs: `cuMemMap failed: cuMemMap(0x7f) -> CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY`

maya (oncall): quick check: which customers on that pool? can someone run `rbac lookup --pool dedicated-west2a-large-3`

akshay: I pulled the routing table — two prod tenants on that pool (team-voice, search-embed). traffic is mixed.

maya (oncall): running `rtr drain --pool dedicated-west2a-large-3 --evict 10m` on a few low-priority jobs to free up KV cache. will also flip auto-fallback to cpu-spot for non-SLO workloads: `infra toggle-fallback --pool dedicated-west2a-large-3 --target cpu-spot`

raj: FYI we had a weird kernel module message on gw-02 earlier, dmesg shows: ```
[ 12345.678901] NVRM: GPU 0: Xid (PCI:0000:3:00): 79, pid=21345, ... cuMemMap failed
[ 12345.679002] NVRM: GPU 0: GPU has fallen off the bus
```

maya (oncall): ok that's suspicious — might be fragmentation + mmap. Obs: KV cache hitrate spiked then dropped. obs-bot: kvcache_evictions=1.2k last 5m.

maya (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) evict ephemeral jobs, 2) shrink per-request kv-cache limit from 512MB->256MB, 3) enable fallback routes, 4) if mem stays >90% escalate to PD escalation policy.

akshay: started evictions, one big batch job (job-9981) evicted, freed ~14GB. mem dropped to 83% on gw-02. good.

maya (oncall): toggled kv cache cap with: ```
curl -XPOST https://ops-api.local/pools/dedicated-west2a-large-3/config -d '{"kv_cache_max_mb":256}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN'
```

maya (oncall): enabling canary fallback for search-embed now (10% traffic)

pagerduty: P22278 acknowledged by maya (oncall) at 1767042015

maya (oncall): mem stable ~82-85% across nodes, gw-02 at 80% now after evicts. customer impact: brief increased latency for search-embed canaries (10% routed to cpu fallback). no errors observed from customer logs yet. tagging customer success to monitor. @sre-manager FYI can we hold off full escalation?

sre-manager: hold for now, good playbook. if another node hits >92% within 10m, escalate to oncall-senior.

raj: leaving note in runbook: possible GPU mmap fragmentation — add followup to run "gpu-defrag --node gw-02 --pool dedicated-west2a-large-3 --dry-run" tomorrow during maintenance window.

akshay: also saw one container retry loop causing repeated allocation attempts, throttled it with `ctr update --max-retries=1 ctnr-117` to avoid hammering NVML.

maya (oncall): switching rotation, hands off to akshay for 30m check. akshay, pls ping here when stable. I've added a timeline. :thumbsup:

akshay: taking over. will monitor metrics and logs. set a temp alert: `gpu_mem > 90% for 2m` -> page oncall-senior if fires.

pagerduty: P22278 updated: owner=akshay, status=acknowledged, severity=major

akshay: initial followup: gw-02 kernel logs look OK now, memory reclaim happening. will leave evictions running and revert kv cache cap back to 512MB once fragmentation confirmed resolved.

maya (oncall): noted — thanks. leaving short postmortem stub: cause=probable kv-cache fragmentation + noisy allocation loop => mitigation=evict noisy jobs, reduce kv cache cap, enable fallback routing. followups: schedule defrag, add guardrail to prevent repeated allocations per-container, add eviction hook to prioritize low-SLO tenants.

obs-bot: metric snapshot attached -> cpu_fallback_rate=0.1, kvcache_evictions=1270, avg_gpu_mem=84%

akshay: 30m check-in: no further spikes, mem holding 78-85%. closing the page in 10m if unchanged.

pagerduty: P22278 resolved by akshay at 1767042350

maya (oncall): thanks team. adding follow-up ticket to infra backlog and tagging search-embed owners for FYI. :white_check_mark:
